title: Inventory Value for an earlier date still counts a part untracked today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test on an earlier day, with 4 in its bin at a cost of $10.00, so the Inventory Value report saved a figure for it on that earlier date (date A).
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Reports in the top bar.
  5. Click Inventory Value.
  6. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  7. Set the as-of date to date A.
  8. Type part A's part number in the report's Search box.
  9. Set the as-of date to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off.

Step 3:

  • Part A reads "Not Tracked".

Step 4:

  • The Reports page opens.

Step 5:

  • The Inventory Value report opens.

Step 6:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 7:

  • The report shows date A.

Step 8:

  • Part A is still listed for date A with Qty 4.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost $40.00 (4 × $10.00).
  • The Totals row reads Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00: turning tracking off today did not change date A's figures.

Step 9:

  • For today part A is not listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part), story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R9: “The Inventory Value report does not include untracked parts.”
  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “The Inventory Value report run for a past date shows each part as it was on that date. Turning tracking off today does not change an earlier date's figures.”
